name: Khudebarta SMS Gateway – Order Notificaiton for WooCommerce
author: graywp

sections.description:
KB SMS Gateway is a lightweight and powerful plugin that integrates the Khudebarta.com SMS gateway with WooCommerce, allowing you to automatically send SMS notifications when a customer places a new order or when the admin updates the order status to processing, completed, cancelled, refunded, or on-hold.

🌐 What is Khudebarta?

Khudebarta is a Bangladeshi SMS gateway service provider offering fast and reliable delivery of promotional, transactional, and bulk SMS. It supports both single and bulk messaging with a simple API, making it ideal for businesses, eCommerce stores, institutions, and more.

This plugin helps WooCommerce store owners in Bangladesh keep customers informed with real-time SMS updates — boosting trust, reducing confusion, and enhancing customer engagement.

✅ Features:

  • 🔔 Send SMS notifications to customers on new WooCommerce orders
  • 🧩 Fully customizable SMS template with dynamic tags like {customer_name}, {order_total}, {order_id}
  • ⚙️ Easy-to-use admin settings page for entering API credentials
  • 🔐 API credentials are stored securely and used only when needed
  • 🇧🇩 Built specifically for Bangladeshi businesses using the Khudebarta SMS platform
  • 🚀 Lightweight and developer-friendly code structure

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

External services

This plugin connects to a third-party SMS gateway to send WooCommerce order notifications to customers’ mobile numbers. It also sends SMS notifications when the admin updates the order status to processing, completed, cancelled, refunded, or on-hold.

Service Name: Khudebarta SMS Gateway
Main Website: http://khudebarta.com
API Endpoint: http://portal.khudebarta.com:3775/sendtext
Purpose: Used to send WooCommerce order SMS notifications.
Data Sent: Customer mobile number, SMS message
Data Received: API response code from Khudebarta SMS gateway
Privacy Policy: https://khudebarta.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://khudebarta.com/terms-and-condition
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > SMS Gateway.
  4. Enter your Client ID, API Key, and Secret Key from Khudebarta.
  5. Enable the “Send SMS on New Order” option.
  6. Customize the SMS template if desired and save changes.
sections.faq:
Is this service free?

No. You must have a paid or trial account at Khudebarta.com to access their SMS API.

Can I customize the SMS message?

Yes. You can use variables like {customer_name}, {order_total}, {order_id} and more to personalize the SMS content.

Where do I get the API credentials?

Log in to your Khudebarta account and go to the API section to find your Client ID, API Key, and Secret Key.

Does this plugin send data to other services?

Only to Khudebarta’s API, for the sole purpose of sending the SMS you configure.
